fit_scope: fit a new transformer inside every inner-training fold and every outer-training fold; fit once on all development rows only after final hyperparameters are frozen

continuous_policy.coercion: numeric conversion; non-finite values become missing
continuous_policy.missing_indicator: always emit one explicit binary missing indicator per continuous feature
continuous_policy.scaling: subtract imputed training-fold mean and divide by imputed training-fold population standard deviation
continuous_policy.constant_scale: replace a non-finite or <1e-12 standard deviation with 1.0

categorical_policy.canonicalization: booleans map to true/false; other values use stripped string representation
categorical_policy.reference: lexicographically first observed non-special training level; if no non-special level exists, drop no level
categorical_policy.encoding: one-hot encode all observed non-reference levels and always emit __MISSING__ and __UNKNOWN__ columns

output_policy.intercept: model fitting adds one unpenalized intercept; transformer emits no intercept
output_policy.column_order: registered block order, then continuous standardized value and missing indicator, then categorical encoded levels in lexicographic order with missing and unknown last
output_policy.P3_P5_invariant: P5 design columns equal P3 design columns followed only by pair_evidence columns

prohibited: encoding a failed local measurement as zero evidence
claim_boundary: This contract fixes feature lineage and preprocessing behavior. It fits no predictive model, estimates no performance, and does not authorize calibration or confirmation outcome access.
